adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to GET /api_v2/organization.json. Returns raw BugHerd JSON under data.
Optional page is the official one-based list page. Returns raw BugHerd JSON under data.
project_id is interpolated as a path segment. Returns raw BugHerd JSON under data.
Admits project_id plus optional page, status, priority, tag, assigned_to_id, external_id, created_since, and updated_since. Returns raw BugHerd JSON under data.
project_id and task_id are interpolated as path segments. Returns raw BugHerd JSON under data.
Dedicated SHOW_ORGANIZATION read of GET /api_v2/organization.json, distinct from credential-only healthcheck.
Optional page and updated_since query parameters.
user_id is a path segment. Optional page, is_active, and created_since.
user_id is a path segment. Optional page, priority, tag, assigned_to_id, created_since, and updated_since.
GET /api_v2/projects/active.json with optional page.
POST /api_v2/projects.json with the nested official project object. Returns 201.
PUT /api_v2/projects/{project_id}.json with a partial nested project object.
DELETE /api_v2/projects/{project_id}.json. Destructive.
POST /api_v2/projects/{project_id}/add_member.json with user_id.
POST /api_v2/projects/{project_id}/add_guest.json with user_id or email.
POST /api_v2/projects/{project_id}/tasks.json wrapping flattened Composio fields in {task: ...}.
PUT /api_v2/projects/{project_id}/tasks/{task_id}.json with the nested official task object.
GET /api_v2/projects/{project_id}/columns.json.
POST /api_v2/projects/{project_id}/columns.json wrapping name and optional position in {column: ...}.
GET /api_v2/projects/{project_id}/columns/{column_id}.json.
PUT /api_v2/projects/{project_id}/columns/{column_id}.json with the nested column object.
POST comments.json wrapping text/user_id/email/is_private in {comment: ...}.
GET attachments.json with optional page.
POST attachments.json wrapping file_name and url in {attachment: ...}.
GET attachments/{attachment_id}.json.
Handwritten multipart POST to /attachments/upload. file_content is UTF-8 or base64.
GET /api_v2/webhooks.json.
POST /api_v2/webhooks.json with event, target_url, and optional project_id.

attachments.create.description: Add an attachment to a task from a publicly accessible URL.

file_name.description: Name of the attachment file (for example, resolution.gif).

project_id.description: Unique identifier of the project containing the task.

task_id.description: Unique identifier of the task to attach the file to.

url.description: Public URL of the file to attach.

attachments.create.title: Create attachment

attachments.get.description: Retrieve filename, URL, and timestamps for a specific task attachment.

attachments.get.title: Show attachment

attachments.upload.description: Upload binary file content and attach it to a task via multipart form data. Provide file_content as UTF-8 text or base64.

file_content.description: Raw file content or base64-encoded bytes to upload.

project_id.description: ID of the project containing the task.

attachments.upload.title: Upload attachment
